propositions: MCP transition_ticket and claim_ticket signatures omit force, reason, caused_by, and ref parameters that are already supported by the library and CLI, making them unreachable over MCP

FastMCP derives JSON schemas and argument models from the handwritten callable signatures and discards undeclared payload keys before the registered callable runs, causing the missing parameters to be dropped even if provided

The MCP adapter forwarding layer independently only passes close_class (transition) and assignee (claim) to the core library functions, so even if parameters were added to the signature they would still be lost
After the 2026-08-18 operator ruling, force is allowed through all surfaces (CLI, library, MCP) with absent certification as the audit signal, making the prior CLI/library-only force policy rescinded

Repair requires adding transition_ticket parameters (force: str | None, reason, caused_by, ref) and claim_ticket parameter (force: str | None), forwarding all unchanged to rebar.transition/rebar.claim, and updating tool prose to reflect the audit model
